name: Demon Face Punching Club - Demo
summary:
# Man, this is hardcore!
No more grooving to electronic music in Neon-Worlds!   
This game is rough, hardcore, punk. A cacophany of violence agains hungry demonheads. They want to feast on you and you need to fist in their faces before they take a bite. Fend them off to the beat of music with real instruments! 

#  Take you to the Demon Shop 

If you truly suck, you can spend your demon juice between song to replenish a life in the Demon Shop.
